annotation.organism: Syntrophomonas wolfei subsp. wolfei (strain DSM 2245B / Goettingen)
function: Together with the chaperonin GroEL, plays an essential role in assisting protein folding. The GroEL-GroES system forms a nano-cage that allows encapsulation of the non-native substrate proteins and provides a physical environment optimized to promote and accelerate protein folding. GroES binds to the apical surface of the GroEL ring, thereby capping the opening of the GroEL channel.
subunit: Heptamer of 7 subunits arranged in a ring. Interacts with the chaperonin GroEL.
similarity: Belongs to the GroES chaperonin family.
